description:
FILED s530b (Opus agent, 2026-10-31), from the Template-Toolkit re-census after #3856.  PRE-EXISTING (ff5f72b5 emits the same).

    package Q;
    our $t;
    $t->{a} = 1;            # also: $Q::r->{k} = 1;  $$Q::r = 1;  $Q::a->[0] = 2;  ${$Q::a}[1] = 3
    print "$t->{a}\n";
perl: 1.  PCL: run-time death `Value of '(p-gethash-deref Q::$t "a") in (boundp '(p-gethash-deref ...)) is ... not a symbol` (a raw SBCL type error).

CAUSE: Pl/ExprToCL.pm's `=` dispatch decides scalar / array / hash assignment by three regexes over the EMITTED left side, `/(?:^|::)\$/` etc.  The element arm before them knows only `(p-gethash `, `(p-aref `, `(p-aslice `, `(p-hslice ` -- not `p-gethash-deref` / `p-aref-deref` / `p-cast-$` -- so those forms fell to the sigil tests, and a QUALIFIED container inside them (`Q::$t`) matched `::$` in the middle of the text: p-scalar-= on a non-symbol place.  Unqualified (`$t` inside a sub, or the file-level `our ($t)` list form, which is not requalified) the text has no `::$` and fell through to the generic p-setf tail, which is right -- so the bug showed only for a qualified name.

Template-Toolkit: Template/Parser.pm:92 `$TAG_STYLE->{ template } = $TAG_STYLE->{ tt2 } = $TAG_STYLE->{ default };` (file-level `our $TAG_STYLE` in package Template::Parser) -- so after #3856 made the module transpile, it died at LOAD and every TT test that processes a template failed (`file error - failed to load Template/Parser.pm`).

FIX (one mechanism): the three sigil tests are ANCHORED -- the sigil must start the text or follow a package prefix with no parenthesis or space (`/^(?:[^()\s]*::)?\$/`), i.e. the left side IS a variable; any other form takes the generic p-setf tail, as its unqualified twin already did.
